root_cause.primary: EVI-MA-03 verified a token before FIRST mount but `ready` was a one-shot boolean never re-evaluated; when the token later expired/went stale the <Viewer> stayed mounted and BaseViewerInitializer rendered raw validTokenNeeded with no recovery path.
root_cause.secondary: silent-failure branch called signInRedirect which can be blocked in the embedded host, dead-ending auth.
root_cause.classification: stale/expired token after TOKEN_READY with no demotion (plus fragile auto-redirect)
root_cause.not_client_instance_mismatch: auth client memoized; same instance drives silent sign-in, getAccessToken, and <Viewer authClient>
root_cause.not_callback_race: SigninCallbackHandler completes handleSignInCallback before returning to /viewer

state_machine.type: ViewerAuthState = CONFIG_MISSING | INITIALIZING | AUTHENTICATING | TOKEN_READY | REAUTH_REQUIRED | ERROR

token_verification.after_silent_signin: getAccessToken() via SAME client -> decideTokenReadiness (authorized + non-empty + not within 30s skew)
token_verification.expiry_reverification: 30s interval while TOKEN_READY; on loss dispatch TOKEN_LOST -> REAUTH_REQUIRED (unmounts Viewer)

failure_ui.app_owned_overlay: 3D BIM authentication required + Reconnect Bentley 3D + Developer PRESENT/MISSING diagnostic

manual_acceptance_steps: Open /viewer; if auth valid, full 3D BIM renders
Normal refresh -> BIM returns OR Reconnect overlay (never only validTokenNeeded)
Click Reconnect -> complete Bentley PKCE -> BIM renders
Confirm Clinical Program + 2D plan + equipment state survived
Select KIUBE -> Hide/Show works; Delete unchanged
stop_condition: Deterministic auth; Viewer mounts only on verified token readiness; raw validTokenNeeded prevented as normal UI; reconnect exists; refresh/expiry tested; app state survives; regressions pass; /viewer on 3000. STOP. Do not start PTS/RTHS/MRT animation/Build 2.
